title: Decentralized Mesh + Permaculture Feedback + Hyper-Efficient Language
intent: Unify decentralized mesh, permaculture self-correction, thermodynamic ledger, and a maximally efficient symbolic language derived from atomic meaning units.
eta_goal: Raise information density and self-correction rate of the entire OpenRoot system by orders of magnitude.
core_framing: Assign core symbols with deep, independently verifiable meaning (example: A = Agape).
Cryptographic hashing of the thermodynamic ledger provides a route to verify that a symbol continues to mean what it claims.
3-letter combinations yield a large address space of atomic meanings (26³ or 36³).
Map the vector space of understanding by chaining 4–7 atomic functions raised to matching magnitude.
Couple the language to mesh networking and permaculture feedback: observe → measure → regulate → replace upstream with higher-η alternative.
optimized_query_patterns: Express this concept in the densest OpenRoot symbolic form that still remains verifiable.
What is the upstream higher-η replacement for this current process?
constraints: Verification via ledger/hash preferred over pure authority
verification_notes: Cryptographic hash of canonical statements; measured reduction in tokens required for equivalent useful output.
next_physical_or_action: Define the first 12 atomic symbols with ledger-backed definitions and publish the hash of the canonical set.
